description: Prepare an upload of a local folder (for example a build output like dist/). Returns a one-time token and a shell command to run; only changed files are transferred. Valid for 60 minutes.

oneOf.description: The uploaded folder becomes the whole site; files not in it are removed.
Uploaded files are added to or replace existing ones; nothing is removed.

mode.description: "replace" (default): the folder becomes the whole site. "merge": add/overwrite only.

name: start_upload
